openUiAnatomy: no published Open UI tooltip anatomy — plain/basic hover tooltip only, union of salt-ds Tooltip (NOT Toggletip), shadcn Tooltip (Radix primitive), M3 plain-tooltip (NOT rich-tooltip). See docs/TOOLTIP-MATRIX.md scope note for why toggletip/rich-tooltip are excluded.

behavior.pattern: APG tooltip pattern: hover/focus opens, Escape/outside dismisses, role=tooltip on the panel wired to the trigger via aria-describedby. Converges across all three systems (contrast Spinner's 3-way role split).
behavior.chassis: skeleton/tooltip.tsx — written from the template's part union; inherits from no design system. Positioning is a minimal rect-measurement approximation, not any of the three real engines (Salt: floating-ui; shadcn: Radix Popper; M3: unsourced) — a declared gap, see docs/TOOLTIP-MATRIX.md behavior.positioning-engine.

rows.note: Salt: true triangle via floating-ui's FloatingArrow. shadcn: true, rendered as a rotated-square diamond (structural, not a runtime toggle). M3 plain-tooltip: false — confirmed absent from the token file, not merely unmodeled.

A genuine two-way structural split, NOT one shared shape with a cosmetic delta. Salt renders floating-ui's FloatingArrow: a real SVG triangle (width 12, height 6, so a 90-degree apex) filled with the panel background and stroked 1px on its two OUTER edges only, the base left open to merge into the panel's own border - TooltipBase.tsx lines 50-58. shadcn renders a rotated square div with NO border (`size-2.5 rotate-45 bg-foreground`), which reads as a pointer purely because the panel covers its inner half. ADDED IN VALIDATION: the skeleton originally drew one rotated square for both. That is fine for shadcn (borderless) but visibly broken for Salt, whose 1px border then outlined all four edges of a rhombus instead of two edges of a triangle - the owner caught it on the render. The shapes are now separate mechanisms, as they are in source.

Salt only. Reassigns ONE indirection property, exactly as Tooltip.css does (`.saltTooltip-error { --tooltip-status-borderColor: var(--salt-status-error-borderColor) }`). Both the panel border AND the arrow's stroke read that property (TooltipBase.tsx passes stroke="var(--tooltip-status-borderColor)" to FloatingArrow), so one reassignment recolours both - which is why this is modelled as an indirection rather than as a direct border-color override.
